A '''factory droid''',<ref name="Infiltration">{{WEGCite|story=Infiltration (adventure)|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref> colloquially known as a '''factory drone''', was a common classification of [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] that operated in [[Factory/Legends|industrial facilities]].<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe" /> Many of these droids operated in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Super Star Wars" /> [[Mazzoney]] used a factory [[Droid/Legends|droid]] permanently mounted at the entrance of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[Mazzoney's]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]], to collect the cover charge for entry.<ref name="Infiltration" />
